rationale: The source SOI lists six Center for Autism and Related Disorders delayed draw term loan rows maturing 10/11/23 with footnote (10). The filing's investment-status table separately reports Non-Accrual amortized cost of 3,589 as of June 30, 2023, so the nonaccrual flag is source-confirmed and localized to these six positions.
